option.name: --backtrace-limit
tip: Set the maximum number of frames in a backtrace.

option.name: --copyright
tip: Print the Ruby copyright.

option.name: --crash-report
tip: Set the template for crash report files.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set the debugging flag ($DEBUG) and $VERBOSE to true.

option.name: --disable
tip: Disable the given features.
Possible values: gems, error_highlight, did_you_mean, syntax_suggest, rubyopt, frozen-string-literal, yjit, zjit, all

option.name: --disable-did_you_mean
tip: Disable the did_you_mean feature.

option.name: --disable-error_highlight
tip: Disable the error_highlight feature.

option.name: --disable-frozen-string-literal
tip: Disable the frozen-string-literal feature.

option.name: --disable-gems
tip: Disable the gems feature.

option.name: --disable-rubyopt
tip: Disable the rubyopt feature.

option.name: --disable-syntax_suggest
tip: Disable the syntax_suggest feature.

option.name: --disable-yjit
tip: Disable the yjit feature.

option.name: --disable-zjit
tip: Disable the zjit feature.

option.name: --dump
tip: Dump the given items.
Possible values: version, copyright, usage, help, yydebug, syntax, parsetree, insns, -optimize, +error-tolerant, +comment

option.name: --enable
tip: Enable the given features.
Possible values: gems, error_highlight, did_you_mean, syntax_suggest, rubyopt, frozen-string-literal, yjit, zjit, all

option.name: --enable-did_you_mean
tip: Enable the did_you_mean feature.

option.name: --enable-error_highlight
tip: Enable the error_highlight feature.

option.name: --enable-frozen-string-literal
tip: Enable the frozen-string-literal feature.

option.name: --enable-gems
tip: Enable the gems feature.

option.name: --enable-rubyopt
tip: Enable the rubyopt feature.

option.name: --enable-syntax_suggest
tip: Enable the syntax_suggest feature.

option.name: --enable-yjit
tip: Enable the yjit feature.

option.name: --enable-zjit
tip: Enable the zjit feature.

option.name: --encoding
tip: Set the default external and internal encodings.

option.name: --external-encoding
tip: Set the default external encoding.

option.name: --help
tip: Print the help message.
-h prints the short form.

option.name: --internal-encoding
tip: Set the default internal encoding.

option.name: --jit
tip: Enable the default JIT for the build; same as --yjit.

option.name: --parser
tip: Set the Ruby parser.
Possible values: parse.y, prism

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set $VERBOSE to true and ignore input from $stdin.

option.name: --version
tip: Print the Ruby version.

option.name: --yjit
tip: Enable the in-process JIT compiler.

option.name: --yjit-call-threshold
tip: Set the number of calls that triggers JIT.
(default 30)

option.name: --yjit-code-gc
tip: Run code GC when the code size reaches the limit.

option.name: --yjit-cold-threshold
tip: Set the global call count after which ISEQs are not compiled.
(default 200K)

option.name: --yjit-disable
tip: Disable YJIT for lazily enabling it with RubyVM::YJIT.enable.

option.name: --yjit-exec-mem-size
tip: Set the hard limit on executable memory in MiB.

option.name: --yjit-log
tip: Enable logging of YJIT compilation activity.

option.name: --yjit-mem-size
tip: Set the soft limit on YJIT memory usage in MiB.
(default 128)

option.name: --yjit-perf
tip: Enable frame pointers and perf profiling.

option.name: --yjit-stats
tip: Enable collecting YJIT statistics.

option.name: --yjit-trace-exits
tip: Record the Ruby source location when exiting from generated code.

option.name: --yjit-trace-exits-sample-rate
tip: Trace exit locations only every Nth occurrence.

option.name: --yydebug
tip: Print the parser log; backward compatibility is not guaranteed.

option.name: --zjit
tip: Enable the method-based JIT compiler.

option.name: --zjit-call-threshold
tip: Set the number of calls that triggers JIT.
(default 30)

option.name: --zjit-disable
tip: Disable ZJIT for lazily enabling it with RubyVM::ZJIT.enable.

option.name: --zjit-log-compiled-iseqs
tip: Log compiled ISEQs to the file, which is truncated.

option.name: --zjit-mem-size
tip: Set the maximum memory ZJIT can use in MiB.
(default 128)

option.name: --zjit-num-profiles
tip: Set the number of profiled calls before JIT.
(default 5)

option.name: --zjit-perf
tip: Dump ISEQ symbols into /tmp/perf-{}.map for Linux perf.

option.name: --zjit-stats
tip: Collect ZJIT stats, optionally writing them to a file.

option.name: --zjit-stats-quiet
tip: Collect ZJIT stats and suppress output.

option.name: --zjit-trace-exits
tip: Record the source of side exits, optionally for one counter.

option.name: --zjit-trace-exits-sample-rate
tip: Set how often side exits are recorded.
Set the input record separator ($/).
-0 for \0; -00 for paragraph mode; -0777 for slurp mode.

option.name: -a
tip: Split each input line ($_) into fields ($F).

option.name: -c
tip: Check syntax without executing.

option.name: -C
tip: Execute the program in the specified directory.

option.name: -e
tip: Execute the given Ruby code; may be repeated.

option.name: -F
tip: Set the input field separator ($;); used with -a.

option.name: -i
tip: Set ARGF in-place mode and create backup files with the given extension.

option.name: -I
tip: Prepend the directory to $LOAD_PATH; may be repeated.

option.name: -l
tip: Set the output record separator ($\) to $/ for line-oriented output.

option.name: -n
tip: Run the program in a gets loop.

option.name: -p
tip: Like -n, but print each line.

option.name: -r
tip: Require the given library before running; may be repeated.

option.name: -s
tip: Define global variables from switches after the program path.

option.name: -S
tip: Search the directories in the PATH environment variable.

option.name: -U
tip: Set Encoding.default_internal to UTF-8.

option.name: -v
tip: Print the version and set $VERBOSE to true.

option.name: -w
tip: Synonym for -W1.

option.name: -W
tip: Set the warning flag ($-W).
0 for silent; 1 for moderate; 2 for verbose.
Possible values: 0, 1, 2, :deprecated, :experimental, :performance, :strict_unused_block
The value must be attached, as in -W2.

option.name: -x
tip: Execute Ruby code starting from a #!ruby line.
